about: Multi-part question set for the Sales Playbook knowledge space (REF H4). Each multi_part question asks two or three distinct things answered by different sections (different sources where possible); required_evidence lists one section per part and expected_answer_facts holds at least one verbatim fact per part, so an answer that covers only one part fails. Six single_part controls, distinct from the retrieval set's questions, show whether any change hurts ordinary questions. Same evidence and fact conventions as sales-playbook-retrieval-v1 (nearest Markdown heading, exact text; token-matched facts). Built on 2026-10-03 from the 17 approved sources, labelled before any run. Split rule: ids that are multiples of three are holdout (4 multi_part, 2 single_part); the rest are tuning.
